component.name: Terminal
टर्मिनल
component.summary: Use the command line in a native terminal
मूल टर्मिनल में कमांड लाइन का उपयोग करें

description.p: Terminal runs local command-line programs in a native, GPU-rendered window with tabs, selection, and search.
It keeps the shell and pseudo-terminal as the authority for process behavior, output, and exit status.
